cover.sub: functions that live inside a class

lines.say: Every call eats ten rupees of my mobile balance!
lines.cap: Every call eats 10 rupees of my mobile balance!

lines.say: An action your phone does? Put it inside the class. A method!
lines.cap: An action your phone does? Put it inside the class. A method!

lines.say: Call is a method. P dot call cuts ten rupees. Forty left!
lines.cap: call is a method. p.call() cuts 10 rupees. 40 left!

lines.say: Why does call need self, if I never pass it?
lines.cap: Why does call need self, if I never pass it?

lines.say: Python passes it for you! P dot call means self is p.
lines.cap: Python passes it for you! p.call() means self is p.
